fns.desc: CONFIG_NAN_USD action-frame handler in hostapd_action_rx checks only 'plen >= 5' before reading mgmt->u.action.u.vs_public_action.variable[0], but variable[0] is byte offset 5 (category[0]+action[1]+oui[2..4]) relative to plen's base -- needs plen >= 6. The sibling CONFIG_DPP branch a few lines above correctly requires 'plen >= 2+4' (=6) for the same variable[0] read. A 5-byte NAN public-action frame from an untrusted peer triggers a 1-byte out-of-bounds read, and the subsequent 'pos++' / 'end - pos' (line 1843-1845) compounds it by advancing past the buffer and potentially underflowing the pointer subtraction passed to hostapd_nan_usd_rx_sdf.
